title: Supply Chain Manager
description: Official Sephora Jeddah-based supply-chain leadership role for Saudi Arabia omni-channel operations across stores and e-commerce. The role owns local supply planning, store replenishment, logistics operations, and 3PL relationship management; drives new-product launches and process improvements; manages inventory availability and last-mile efficiency; coordinates with Dubai HQ on S&OP and KPI action plans; and leads a team of 7 across logistics and planning.
